Your privacy choices

What you can see, correct, export or delete in Dukan ERP yourself, and how to ask TSX-MR for the rest.

Version 1.0 (draft) · Effective date not set

Your own account

  • See your sign-in identifier and verify your WhatsApp number in the app, under More → Your account.
  • Sign a phone out of your account under More → Devices — for example when a phone is lost.
  • Delete your account in the app, under More → Your account → Delete account. The account deletion page explains what happens.

If you work for a business

Your name and contact details are kept by the business you work for. Its Owner can correct them, or deactivate your login, in the app under Team. Ask the Owner first; if that is not possible, write to privacy@tsxmr.com.

For a business

  • The Owner, and staff allowed to see reports, can share the daily and monthly reports as PDF files and export reports as spreadsheet files from the app.
  • There is no button that exports everything Dukan ERP holds about a business or a person. To ask for a copy, write to privacy@tsxmr.com.

If you are a customer of a shop

A shop decides what it records about its customers, such as a name or a telephone number used for a sale or a money exchange. Ask the shop first.

The app has no way today for a shop to correct or delete one customer’s record on its own. A shop, or a customer who cannot reach the shop, can write to privacy@tsxmr.com; what TSX-MR can then do depends on the records a shop must keep and on the law that applies. Pending decision: privacy_law

Messages, advertising and tracking

Dukan ERP sends only the messages the service needs, such as verification codes and set-up instructions. It sends no marketing, shows no advertising and does not track you across other apps or websites, so there is nothing to opt out of.

On this website

This website keeps only your language and light or dark theme in your browser, and a sign-in cookie while you are signed in to a business account. You can clear them in your browser’s settings; nothing else needs a choice.

Ask TSX-MR

For anything not listed here — a copy of your information, a correction you cannot make yourself, or an objection — write to privacy@tsxmr.com from an address or number on your account, so that TSX-MR can check it is you.

The rights the law gives you, how quickly TSX-MR must answer, and where you may complain are being confirmed with legal counsel. Pending decision: privacy_law
